description: Advisories accepted for now, each with why and until when (scripts/audit-report.mjs, policy in task_4_security.md §6). An expired entry fails the audit; an entry no longer needed is reported.

entries.reason: Storybook 9 (web/ devDependency). Only `npm run storybook` / `build-storybook` use it, on our own source files, on the developer's machine or in CI; nothing of it ships to browsers. No AbortSignal or untrusted pattern reaches glob. npm's only suggested fix is a downgrade to Storybook 8.5. Re-check with Storybook 10.

Storybook 9 (web/ devDependency). Only `npm run storybook` / `build-storybook` use it, on our own source files, on the developer's machine or in CI; nothing of it ships to browsers. The patterns are the fixed stories globs in .storybook/main.ts, not user input, so the denial of service cannot be triggered. Re-check with Storybook 10.

Storybook 9 (web/ devDependency). Only `npm run storybook` / `build-storybook` use it, on our own source files, on the developer's machine or in CI; nothing of it ships to browsers. Our tests run on Vitest 5.1 (fixed); this copy is Storybook's own, used by its 'storybook/test' mocking, which our stories do not use, and its dev server listens on localhost only. Fixed in Storybook 10.6.7: planned upgrade.

@lhci/cli (devDependency, Lighthouse CI in the CI job only) → puppeteer → proxy-agent → get-uri → basic-ftp. It is reached only for ftp:// URLs or PAC proxy files; Lighthouse CI here opens http://127.0.0.1 pages with no proxy, so the FTP client never runs. npm's only suggested fix is a downgrade to @lhci/cli 0.13 (older Lighthouse). Denial of service of the CI step at worst.
